Arcadia is the right Santorini hotel for travelers who want activity and options rather than seclusion — and for families, the infrastructure is real; they’ll tell you the same. Great if you like a bit of a scene; not the move if you want exclusivity and quiet. Planning a wedding at either — room blocks at Arcadia, a buyout at Epitome — is exactly what I do.

verdict.h2: Canaves wins the top of the list. Andronis wins room for room.
paras: If you only get one Santorini trip, I’d start with Canaves. Oia Suites is the best hotel I saw on the island for first-time visitors — set higher on the Caldera than most, which buys the one thing money usually can’t here, privacy — and Epitome was my favorite hotel across nine islands, with the best sunset in Greece and no age restrictions. Those are the two seats Canaves holds in my Greece Top 10, and the River Pool Suite at Oia Suites was the single best suite I saw across 38 hotels.

But Andronis makes a promise Canaves doesn’t: a water feature in every room, at every property. If the picture in your head is a plunge pool on a cave terrace at 8am, Boutique delivers it more reliably and usually a few hundred a night below Oia Suites. Andronis also owns the two specialists — Concept for the spa, Arcadia for kids and a bit of a scene. Practically, the choice usually resolves on one question: are you booking the hotel, or booking the room?

il-sereno-vs-passalacqua.deck: Ten minutes apart by boat and nothing alike. Il Sereno is the best true lakefront hotel on Lake Como. Passalacqua is a whimsical 18th-century villa you won’t find anywhere else in the world. Both are built for couples, and the right one depends on how you want the trip to feel.

verdict.h2: A villa that feels like home, or the best seat on the water?
paras: Passalacqua is unlike anywhere else in the world. It’s whimsical, the idea is that it’s your home, and because only hotel guests can use the restaurants and spa, it feels genuinely exclusive. It’s peaceful and calm, the spa is beautiful, and the tennis court is one of the most iconic anywhere. Moltrasio is a quiet village with no tourists, which is lovely, but there isn’t much to do there.

Il Sereno is the best true lakefront hotel on Lake Como. Every room looks at the water, the pool is heated and on land, and I couldn’t find a single fault when I stayed. It’s private and quiet in a different way: modern, calm and right on the lake.

And if you can’t choose, don’t. The two hotels are almost directly across the water from each other. Two nights at each, with a ten-minute private boat in between, is the trip I’d book for a honeymoon. Here’s the Passalacqua + Il Sereno pairing.

il-sereno-vs-passalacqua.guide_h2: What to know before you choose

paras: Both, for different couples. Passalacqua is a couple’s retreat. The hotel says it’s family friendly, but I’d book it for honeymooners, or for two couples traveling together. Il Sereno is for the couple who wants to be on the water with a great pool and a very good bed.
If the budget allows, split the trip. Two or three nights at each gives you two honeymoons in one, and the move between them is a ten-minute boat ride.

guide.h3: Lake views: the difference people miss
paras: Il Sereno sits right on the water, and every room looks at the lake. It’s the best true lakefront hotel on Como.

Passalacqua is a terraced garden property. It has some lake-view rooms, but most rooms, even in the Palazzo, look over the gardens to the lake in the distance rather than straight onto the water. If the view matters most, ask me for a lakeside room.
At Il Sereno, entry rooms get a partial view, some through the trees. The Grand Suite is where it gets special, with the head-on view and a private terrace.

At Passalacqua, the rooms in the Palazzo and the lakeside rooms are generously sized. Rooms elsewhere on the property can be a bit small. The Junior Suite Al Lago is the one I show couples first, and with so few rooms, it’s the hardest confirmation on the lake.

guide.h3: Dining, the spa and the honest notes
paras: Passalacqua has only two restaurants, so plan to eat off property some nights. By boat is the best way to do it, and I can arrange it. Its spa is Moroccan-inspired, with vaulted ceilings, old stone columns, pierced brass lanterns and peacock wicker chairs, and an underground tunnel connects it to the lower gardens, which I loved. One small thing: clients who stayed recently found the pool service slow and had to flag someone down to order.
Il Sereno has a Michelin restaurant on the water, its own fleet of Riva boats for dinners elsewhere, and a hot tub in the old boathouse that you can book privately by the hour.

faq: Which is better, Il Sereno or Passalacqua?

They’re different. Passalacqua is a whimsical 18th-century villa that feels like your own home, and only hotel guests can get in. Il Sereno is the best true lakefront hotel on Lake Como, modern and private, with lake views from every room. Or split your stay between them.
Can you visit Passalacqua without staying there?
Generally, no. The restaurants and spa are for hotel guests only. If you’re a client of mine staying nearby, or Passalacqua is sold out for your dates, I can sometimes arrange a lunch or a tour.
Do all rooms at Passalacqua have a lake view?
No. A handful of lakeside rooms look out over the water, but most rooms look over the terraced gardens to the lake in the distance. Every room at Il Sereno sees the lake.
Is Il Sereno cheaper than Passalacqua?
Generally, yes. Il Sereno’s Grand Suite starts around what an entry room costs at Passalacqua. Rates change by season, so ask me for your dates.
Can you stay at both?
Yes, and it’s the trip I recommend for honeymoons. They are about ten minutes apart by private boat. See my Passalacqua + Il Sereno pairing.
Are they good for families?

Not really. Passalacqua says it’s family friendly, but to me it’s a couple’s retreat, and Il Sereno is built for couples too. For a family trip, I’d look at Grand Hotel Tremezzo or the Mandarin Oriental.

verdict.h2: A Wes Anderson set, or the lake’s grand estate?
paras: Grand Hotel Tremezzo is just a fun hotel. The valets made me feel welcome the moment I arrived, there are five restaurants and lots of corners to explore, and the tiered gardens behind the hotel are stunning. Book a junior suite or above: the lake-view rooms with balconies are spacious, beautifully restored, and feel like they sit right on top of the lake. Know that it’s sceney, in an influencer, everyone-taking-photos way, and outside guests come in droves.

Villa d’Este is the classic. The gardens and the villa on the lakefront are beautiful, the dining was fantastic, and the service is polished and warm. With eight clay courts, it’s the best hotel on the lake for a tennis trip with friends, especially if you take one of the estate’s private villas.
If you want to explore the lake, choose Tremezzo. If you want the hotel to be the destination, choose Villa d’Este.

Tremezzo is in the central section of the lake, facing Bellagio, so Varenna and Villa del Balbianello are short hops by boat. Cernobbio is at the southern tip, ten minutes from the town of Como and about an hour from Milan, but further from the mid-lake villages.

paras: Grand Hotel Tremezzo, for most families. It’s lively, there’s lots to do, and the pools are a big draw. One thing to know: the property is built into the hillside, so there are a lot of stairs. Villa d’Este suits multigenerational trips well.

Both hotels have a pool floating on the lake. Personally, I’m not a fan of floating pools: they rock with the water and can make you queasy. At Grand Hotel Tremezzo, my favorite is the pool up in the tiered gardens. If a calm, heated pool matters to you, Il Sereno’s is built on land.

The hotel recently reworked its rooms to add more suites and junior suites, which was a smart move.

guide.h3: For tennis: eight courts, or one beautiful one
paras: Villa d’Este has eight clay courts, which makes it the best hotel on the lake for a tennis trip with friends, especially paired with one of the estate’s private villas.
Grand Hotel Tremezzo has a single, beautiful clay court tucked into its gardens. It’s perfect for a game or two between swims.

faq: Which is better, Grand Hotel Tremezzo or Villa d'Este?

Grand Hotel Tremezzo is better for exploring the lake and for families, and it’s more fun and sceney. Villa d’Este is better if you want a polished grand estate close to Milan, great dining and tennis.
Is Grand Hotel Tremezzo busy?
Yes. Outside guests are welcome and they come in large numbers, and it’s a popular spot for photos. Staying there, you’ll share the public spaces with day visitors.
Which rooms are best at Grand Hotel Tremezzo?
The junior suites and above with lake views and balconies. They’re spacious, beautifully restored and have gorgeous bathrooms. Garden-view rooms look out on pretty gardens and cost less.
Does Villa d'Este have tennis courts?
Yes, eight clay courts, which makes it the best hotel on Lake Como for a tennis trip with friends.
Is Grand Hotel Tremezzo good for families?
Yes, it’s one of the most family-friendly hotels on the lake. Be aware there are a lot of stairs.
Who owns Grand Hotel Tremezzo?
The De Santis family, who also opened Passalacqua in Moltrasio.

verdict.h2: Why I’d choose Villa d’Este
paras: Villa d’Este won me over with its gardens, the villa on the lakefront and a fantastic lunch. Service is polished and warm, it felt more lively than Serbelloni in a good way, and recent client stays have been very positive. I’m told they plan to reduce the number of rooms and modernize, which will put it in the same tier as Il Sereno, Passalacqua and Grand Hotel Tremezzo.

Villa Serbelloni is an interesting hotel, and I’m still making up my mind about it. It’s very historic and beautifully kept, the modern spa is stunning, the speakeasy bar is a gem, and in summer it would be the best hotel on this list for swimming in the lake. But the decor is a bit too old for my taste, and the location is the bigger issue: Bellagio is incredibly crowded. I was there in October; I can’t imagine July and August.
If you love old Italian hotels and art, and Bellagio is the point of your trip, Serbelloni is a beautiful choice. Otherwise, I’d book Villa d’Este.

Honestly, I’d steer most clients away from it. Bellagio is the lake’s most famous village, and it’s packed with day-trippers. It was crowded when I stayed in October; July and August would be a nightmare. You can visit Bellagio easily by boat from almost anywhere on the lake and come home somewhere calmer.

Its spa is the other surprise. In a hotel this historic, I didn’t expect something so modern and beautiful. It’s a genuine reason to book.

faq: Which is better, Villa d'Este or Villa Serbelloni?

For most travelers, Villa d’Este. It has beautiful gardens, eight clay courts, fantastic dining and warm, polished service, and it’s away from Bellagio’s crowds. Villa Serbelloni suits travelers who love very historic hotels and want to be in Bellagio.
Is Bellagio too crowded?
In my experience, yes. It was crowded even in October, and July and August are far busier. I usually suggest staying elsewhere and visiting Bellagio by boat.
Which Lake Como hotel is best for swimming in the lake?
Villa Serbelloni, of the hotels I’ve seen. It has a pool, a beach and a floating pier you can jump into the lake from.
Does Villa Serbelloni have a spa?
Yes, and it’s one of the hotel’s best features: a stunning, modern spa that contrasts beautifully with the historic hotel around it.
Is Villa Serbelloni formal?
The service is formal, but warm. I never felt unwelcome.
Does Villa d'Este have tennis courts?
Yes, eight clay courts. It’s the hotel I’d choose on Lake Como for a tennis trip with friends.

verdict.h2: A scene, or a hideaway?
paras: The EDITION is a neat hotel, but it isn’t for everyone. It’s lively and social, the spa and gym are outstanding, and the two-bedroom suite is good value for a family. Book a lake-view room on the third floor or above, and know that dining on property is limited and there’s no town at the door.

Il Sereno is the best true lakefront hotel on Lake Como. I couldn’t find a single fault when I stayed: the design, the heated pool, the private hot tub in the old boathouse, the quality of every detail. Because Torno is tiny and the hotel is reachable only by its guests or by boat, it never feels busy.
If you want energy and a great gym, choose the EDITION. If you want the hotel to be the reason you came, choose Il Sereno.

The EDITION is modern and social, the way the brand is everywhere: white, neutrals, green marble and arches, its signature Le Labo scent, and a lively bar and pool. The crowd is younger and mostly American.
Il Sereno is modern in a quieter way. The feel is Japanese-minimalist and warm-industrial, with glass, walnut and stone, and there’s even a listening suite. It’s designed for couples who want calm.
The EDITION is in Cadenabbia, next door to Grand Hotel Tremezzo, where you can walk for meals. There’s little else nearby, but Bellagio and Varenna are a short boat ride away.
Il Sereno is in Torno, near the southern end of the lake and about an hour from Milan. The hotel’s own boats make dinners across the lake easy.

At the EDITION, book a lake-view room on the third floor or above. Lower floors sit above the loud casual restaurant, and non-lake-view rooms face the spa across the street or an interior courtyard. A non-lake-view booking won’t be upgraded to a lake view without a paid supplement.
At Il Sereno, every room sees the lake, but entry rooms get a partial view, some through the trees. The Grand Suite is where it gets special.

The road up from the town of Como takes 45 minutes to an hour. I arrange a private car from Milan to the water in Como, then a private boat to the hotel’s dock. I arrived at the EDITION this way, and it’s the arrival I recommend.

faq: Which is better, the Lake Como EDITION or Il Sereno?

They suit different travelers. The EDITION is lively and social, with an excellent spa and gym. Il Sereno is private and quiet, the best true lakefront hotel on Lake Como, with exceptional quality throughout. Choose by whether you want a scene or a hideaway.
Where is the Lake Como EDITION?
In Cadenabbia, in the middle of the lake on the west shore, right next door to Grand Hotel Tremezzo.
Which rooms should I book at the EDITION?
A lake-view room on the third floor or above. Lower floors sit above the loud casual restaurant, and non-lake-view rooms face the spa across the street or an interior courtyard.
Will the EDITION upgrade me to a lake view?
The hotel told me a non-lake-view booking won’t be upgraded to a lake view without a paid supplement. A standard lake-view booking can be upgraded to a lake-view loft or suite.
Which is quieter?
Il Sereno, by a wide margin. Torno is a tiny village, and the hotel can only be reached by guests or by boat.
Which is better for a honeymoon?
Il Sereno, for most couples. For an even bigger honeymoon, pair it with Passalacqua across the water. See my Passalacqua + Il Sereno pairing.
